name: Akagawa Jirou: Majo-tachi no Nemuri
original_name: 赤川次郎 魔女たちの眠り
source: After getting a weird call for help while in the office, Toshio has a dream about a girl from his childhood. When the next morning the papers say she has killed herself he's sure she was the one that called and he decides to go off to investigate the mountain village where she supposedly burned herself to death.
translation: 俊夫在办公室接到一通古怪的求救电话后，梦见了童年时认识的一名少女。第二天早晨，报纸报道那名少女已经自杀。利夫确信打来电话的人正是她，于是决定前往据说是她自焚身亡之处的山村展开调查。
